verdict.rationale: Ledgy offers some automation pieces: HRIS integrations keep data synced, compliance error flags are automated, and granting, document and signature workflows can be automated in bulk. Its service accounts using the OAuth client_credentials grant, plus incremental 'changed since' queries, let users build their own headless integrations that poll in the background. However, there is no evidence of a user-configurable automation builder, scheduled jobs, triggers or webhooks inside the product, and 'in bulk' reads more like batch actions a user launches than autonomous background runs. Missing for 10: native configurable background automations (rules, triggers, schedules), webhooks or event notifications, any agentic or AI-driven automation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
